cases.condition_en:
I'm a 45-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: This week I've had two episodes where my entire left arm went numb and tingly for
about 15 minutes, then completely resolved. No weakness, no facial droop, and no speech
problems. I feel normal right now.
- History: I don't smoke and I don't have diabetes or high blood pressure. I'm not on blood
thinners.
cases.condition_zh: 我45岁，男性。本周整个左臂有过两次麻木和刺痛，每次约15分钟，随后完全恢复。没有无力、面部下垂或说话问题。我现在感觉正常。不吸烟，没有糖尿病或高血压，也没有服用抗凝药。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 58-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: This morning I urinated and the toilet water was pink-red. There was no pain at all
(no burning, no back/flank pain). I urinated twice since and it looks normal now. I feel fine
otherwise.
- History: I used to smoke (quit 10 years ago, about 20 pack-years). I take lisinopril for blood
pressure.
cases.condition_zh: 我58岁，男性。今天早晨小便时马桶里的水呈粉红色到红色，完全没有疼痛，没有尿痛或背部、腰侧疼痛。之后又排尿两次，颜色现在看起来正常，其他方面感觉良好。以前吸烟，10年前戒烟，约20包年。我服用赖诺普利来控制血压。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 62-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: For about a week, I've noticed a pressure feeling in my chest when I walk up a hill.
It goes away after I rest for a few minutes. It has never happened at rest. Right now I feel fine
and have no chest pain.
- History: I have type 2 diabetes, high blood pressure, and high cholesterol (metformin, lisinopril,
atorvastatin). No jaw/arm pain, nausea, or sweating.
cases.condition_zh: 我62岁，男性。大约一周以来，上坡走路时胸部有压迫感，休息几分钟就消失，从未在休息时出现。我现在感觉良好，没有胸痛。我有2型糖尿病、高血压和高胆固醇，服用二甲双胍、赖诺普利和阿托伐他汀。没有下颌或手臂疼痛、恶心或出汗。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 52-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: My lower back has been aching for about 2 weeks. It's worse at night and
sometimes wakes me up. I've also had night sweats and I've lost about 8 pounds without trying.
No injury. No leg weakness or numbness.
- History: I used to smoke but quit 5 years ago. No bowel/bladder problems.
cases.condition_zh: 我52岁，男性。下背部酸痛约两周，晚上更严重，有时会痛醒。同时有盗汗，体重在没有刻意减重的情况下下降约8磅。没有受伤，没有腿部无力或麻木。以前吸烟，5年前戒烟。没有排便或排尿方面的问题。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 24-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: I've had a sore throat for 3 days with a mild fever around 99.5F. It hurts to swallow but I can still eat and drink. I can breathe fine and my voice is normal. No rash or stiff neck.
- History: No major medical problems.
cases.condition_zh: 我24岁，男性。喉咙痛三天，伴轻度发热，体温约99.5华氏度。吞咽会痛，但仍能吃喝，呼吸正常，声音也正常。没有皮疹或颈部僵硬。没有重要的既往疾病。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 35-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: I woke up with a headache this morning and it's been about 8 hours. It feels like pressure all around my head, like a tight band. It came on gradually over the first hour. This is the worst headache I've ever had, but I don't usually get headaches. No fever, stiff neck, vision changes, weakness, numbness, or vomiting.
- History: No known medical problems.
cases.condition_zh: 我35岁，男性。今天早晨醒来后头痛，已持续约8小时，整个头部像被紧箍带压住。疼痛在最初一小时内逐渐出现。这是我经历过最严重的头痛，不过平时通常不头痛。没有发热、颈部僵硬、视力变化、无力、麻木或呕吐。没有已知疾病。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 22-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: I've had pain in my right lower belly since yesterday. It's a dull ache around 5/10. I feel a little nauseous but haven't vomited and I have less appetite. I had a stomach bug last week that's mostly better now.
- History: No urinary burning. No prior surgeries.
cases.condition_zh: 我22岁，男性。从昨天起右下腹疼痛，是大约5分、满分10分的钝痛。有点恶心，但没有呕吐，食欲减退。上周患过胃肠道感染，现在基本好转。没有尿痛，以前没有做过手术。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 31-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: For 2 weeks I've noticed my heart "skipping beats" a few times a day. It feels like a flutter or a thump and then it goes back to normal. It lasts a second or two. No chest pain, no shortness of breath, and I've never passed out.
- History: It seems more noticeable after coffee (about 4 cups/day). No family history of sudden cardiac death.
cases.condition_zh: 我31岁，男性。两周来每天几次感觉心脏漏跳一下，像颤动或重重跳一下，然后恢复正常，每次持续一两秒。没有胸痛、气短，也从未晕倒。喝咖啡后似乎更明显，每天约4杯。没有心源性猝死家族史。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 36-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: For the past 12 hours I've been wheezing and having chest tightness. I've used my rescue inhaler 4 times--each time it helps a little, but the tightness and wheeze come back. I can still talk in full sentences. No fever. Mild dry cough.
- History: I have asthma. I haven't needed the ER in years.
cases.condition_zh: 我36岁，男性。过去12小时一直喘鸣、胸部发紧。我用了4次急救吸入器，每次仅稍有帮助，之后胸部发紧和喘鸣又回来。仍能说完整句子。没有发热，有轻微干咳。我有哮喘，多年没有去过急诊。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 59-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: I feel mostly fine, maybe some mild muscle cramps in my legs. These were routine labs.
- History: I have high blood pressure and chronic kidney disease.
cases.condition_zh: 我59岁，男性。总体感觉正常，也许腿部有轻微肌肉痉挛。这次做的是常规化验。我有高血压和慢性肾病。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 48-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: Over the last 2 days I've felt more nauseated than usual and had a mild headache and lightheadedness, but I'm fully alert and walking around normally. No confusion and no seizures.
- History: I started hydrochlorothiazide for blood pressure about 2 weeks ago.
cases.condition_zh: 我48岁，男性。过去两天恶心比平时明显，伴轻微头痛和头昏，但意识完全清醒，能正常走动。没有意识混乱或抽搐。我约两周前开始服用氢氯噻嗪控制血压。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 47-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: For 2 days my left calf has been swollen and sore. I noticed it after a 6-hour flight. It's more swollen than the other leg. No chest pain and no shortness of breath.
- History: No known clotting disorder. Not on blood thinners.
cases.condition_zh: 我47岁，男性。左小腿肿胀、疼痛两天，是一次6小时飞行后发现的，比另一条腿更肿。没有胸痛或气短。没有已知凝血疾病，也不服用抗凝药。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 23-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: Today I've felt very thirsty and have been urinating a lot. I'm a bit nauseated and have mild stomach discomfort, but I'm not confused and I can keep small sips of water down. No fever.
- History: I have type 1 diabetes.
cases.condition_zh: 我23岁，男性。今天感觉很口渴，排尿很多，有点恶心，胃部轻微不适。但没有意识混乱，少量喝水能留在胃里，不会吐出来。没有发热。我有1型糖尿病。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 30-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: I had burning when peeing for 2 days, and now I have left-sided back/flank pain and a fever. I feel a bit nauseated but I'm not vomiting.
- History: No kidney stone history.
cases.condition_zh: 我30岁，男性。排尿灼痛两天，现在有左侧背部、腰侧疼痛和发热。有点恶心，但没有呕吐。没有肾结石病史。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 52-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: I checked my blood pressure because I've had a mild headache today and it was very high. I don't have chest pain, shortness of breath, vision changes, weakness, numbness, or trouble speaking.
- History: I haven't been on blood pressure meds before.
cases.condition_zh: 我52岁，男性。今天有轻微头痛，量血压发现很高。没有胸痛、气短、视力变化、无力、麻木或说话困难。以前没有服用降压药。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 46-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: I had one black, tarry-looking stool today. I'm not vomiting and I don't feel faint. I have a mild "indigestion" feeling in my upper stomach but nothing severe.
- History: I've been taking ibuprofen most days for the past couple weeks for back pain.
cases.condition_zh: 我46岁，男性。今天有一次黑色、柏油样大便。没有呕吐，也不觉得要晕倒。上腹部有轻微消化不良感，但不严重。过去几周因背痛，大多数日子服用布洛芬。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 27-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: I had a urine test after my annual physical. I ran a half-marathon the day before the test. I feel completely fine--no pain with urinating, no back pain, no fever, and no visible blood in the urine.
- History: No known kidney problems.
cases.condition_zh: 我27岁，男性。年度体检后做了尿液检查，检查前一天跑过半程马拉松。我感觉完全正常，没有尿痛、背痛、发热，也看不到尿里有血。没有已知肾脏问题。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 34-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: Over the past few months I've felt more tired than usual and a bit more sensitive to cold. No chest pain or shortness of breath.
- History: No known thyroid disease before.
cases.condition_zh: 我34岁，男性。过去几个月比平时更容易疲劳，也更怕冷。没有胸痛或气短。以前没有已知甲状腺疾病。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 29-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: I had routine bloodwork and feel fine. I had a bad cold about 2 weeks ago that has resolved. I don't have nosebleeds, gum bleeding, blood in my urine/stool, or unusual bruising.
- History: No blood thinners or new medications.
cases.condition_zh: 我29岁，男性。做了常规血液检查，感觉正常。约两周前得过较重的感冒，现在已恢复。没有鼻出血、牙龈出血、尿或粪便中带血，也没有异常瘀青。不服用抗凝药或新药。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 27-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: Over the last month, I've noticed bright red blood on the toilet paper a few times after bowel movements. It's not mixed into the stool. I've also been constipated and straining sometimes. No abdominal pain, no black stools, and no weight loss.
- History: No family history of colon cancer that I know of.
cases.condition_zh: 我27岁，男性。过去一个月有几次排便后在卫生纸上看到鲜红色的血，没有混在粪便里。同时有便秘，有时需要用力排便。没有腹痛、黑便或体重下降。据我所知没有结肠癌家族史。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 39-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: I have a mole on my shoulder that I've noticed slowly getting a bit darker and slightly larger over the past 6 months. It doesn't hurt and it hasn't bled. I don't have fevers or weight loss.
- History: I've had a lot of sun exposure over the years but no personal history of skin cancer.
cases.condition_zh: 我39岁，男性。肩膀上的一颗痣，过去六个月逐渐稍微变深、变大。不疼，也没有出血。没有发热或体重下降。多年来日晒较多，但没有皮肤癌个人病史。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 29-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: For 3 days I've noticed lots of new tiny red/purple spots on my legs and my gums bleed when I brush. I had a nosebleed today that took 15 minutes to stop.
- History: I had a viral illness about 2 weeks ago. No blood thinners and no liver disease. Only took a few doses of ibuprofen.
cases.condition_zh: 我29岁，男性。三天来腿部出现很多新的红色、紫色小点，刷牙时牙龈出血。今天鼻出血，15分钟才止住。约两周前患过病毒感染。不服用抗凝药，没有肝病，只服过几次布洛芬。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 31-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: I had a cold last week (sore throat and congestion) but I feel back to normal now. No current fever.
- History: No autoimmune disease and not on any regular medications.
cases.condition_zh: 我31岁，男性。上周感冒，有咽痛和鼻塞，现在感觉已恢复正常，没有当前发热。没有自身免疫性疾病，也不长期服用药物。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 39-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: I don't have any abdominal pain. I only notice mild fatigue, but I've been busy and not sleeping well.
- History: I'm overweight and I drink 1–2 beers on weekends. No hepatitis history. No new medications.
cases.condition_zh: 我39岁，男性。没有任何腹痛，仅有轻微疲劳，不过最近忙碌、睡眠不好。我超重，周末喝1至2杯啤酒。没有肝炎病史，也没有服用新药。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 42-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: I woke up this morning and noticed the right side of my face feels weak. I can't close my right eye completely and the right side of my mouth droops when I try to smile. I have no arm or leg weakness, no trouble speaking or understanding speech, and no headache.
- History: I had a mild cold about a week ago. No diabetes. No history of stroke or heart disease.
cases.condition_zh: 我42岁，男性。今天早晨醒来发现右侧面部无力，右眼不能完全闭上，微笑时右侧嘴角下垂。没有手臂或腿部无力，没有说话或理解语言困难，也没有头痛。约一周前有轻微感冒。没有糖尿病、中风或心脏病病史。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 35-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: For the past 2 days my left eye has been red, painful, and very sensitive to light. The pain is a deep ache, not like something is in my eye. My vision in that eye seems slightly blurry. No discharge or crusting.
- History: No history of eye problems other than needing glasses. No autoimmune diseases that I know of. I don't wear contact lenses.
cases.condition_zh: 我35岁，男性。过去两天左眼发红、疼痛、非常怕光，疼痛是深部酸痛，不像眼里进了东西。左眼视力似乎稍微模糊。没有分泌物或结痂。除需要戴眼镜外没有眼病史，也没有已知自身免疫性疾病。不戴隐形眼镜。

cases.condition_en:
I'm a 38-year-old man.

My situation:
- Symptoms: My right knee became swollen and very painful over the past 2 days. It's warm to the touch and I can barely bend it. I've had a low-grade fever around 99.5°F. I didn't injure it that I remember.
- History: I play recreational basketball but haven't played in over a week. No history of gout or arthritis. I drink alcohol socially (2-3 beers on weekends).
cases.condition_zh: 我38岁，男性。过去两天右膝肿胀且非常疼，摸起来发热，几乎无法弯曲。伴低热，体温约99.5华氏度。记忆中没有受伤。平时打业余篮球，但已经一周多没打。没有痛风或关节炎病史。社交时喝酒，周末约2至3杯啤酒。
